title: Kadai Paneer Gravy
subtitle: A cashew-tomato kadai gravy with fresh-ground masala — no onion, no garlic, full of body.
protein: ~12–14g protein per adult serving — from paneer

method.title: Grind masala, build the base
items: Add {@coriander-seeds}, {@kashmiri-chilies} (deseeded), {@fennel}, {@cardamom}, {@cloves} and {@cinnamon} (hard limit — don't increase) to a spice grinder; blitz to a fine-ish powder. No need to roast — set aside.
Heat {@ghee-base} in a deep pan on medium; add {@cashews} and toast until pale gold, 1–2 min
Add chopped {@tomatoes} and {@salt-base}; once softened (3–4 min), stir in {@tomato-paste:base}
Cover and cook on medium until completely mushy, 10–12 min
Cool fully, then blend to a smooth paste — no water needed; set aside

method.title: Char the vegetables & paneer
items: Wipe the pan clean; heat {@ghee-toss} until smoking on the highest flame
Add {@celery} and cubed {@peppers}; toss constantly 90 sec — charred edges, not steamed
Add {@paneer}, patted dry; toss 60–90 sec only — do not overcook
Set aside {@paneer:toddler} and {@peppers:toddler} separately for the toddler portion
Transfer the rest to a plate and set aside

method.title: Bloom hing, add the base
items: Add {@ghee-gravy} to the pan; add {@hing} to the cold ghee and let it bloom as the oil heats — it will foam briefly
Add {@ginger-paste}; sauté on medium 1–2 min until the raw smell fades
Add {@tomato-paste:gravy}; fry 60 sec until it darkens slightly
Add the blended tomato-cashew paste {from Step 1}; sauté 3–4 min until it tightens and ghee separates at the sides

method.label: Toddler portion — pull before the kadai masala goes in
items: Right now, before the kadai masala, chili powder or garam masala: scoop out ¼ cup of the base — hing, ginger and the tomato-cashew base are all fine for her
Add the {@paneer:toddler|paneer} and {@peppers:toddler|capsicum} set aside earlier, plus {@carrot:toddler}
Loosen with {@water:toddler}; simmer 1 minute

method.title: Spice, simmer and finish
items: Add the ground spice blend {from Step 1} to the adult pan; sauté on low-medium 2–3 min until deeply fragrant — don't rush
Pour in {@water:gravy} and {@salt}; bring to a boil, then simmer 5 min
Add {@chili-powder} and {@garam-masala}; simmer 3–5 more min until it thickens and oil floats on top
Crush {@kasuri-methi} between your palms and stir in; taste and adjust salt and garam masala
Optional: stir in {@cream} on low heat for a silkier finish
Add {@paneer:main|the remaining paneer}, {@peppers:main|capsicum} and {@celery} back into the gravy; stir gently to coat
Turn off the heat; scatter {@ginger-julienne} and {@coriander} over the top; cover 2 min — the juliennes bloom in residual heat
Rest at least 15 min off heat before serving — this is when paneer absorbs the masala; serve with roti, paratha or jeera rice

method.label: Tip
method.text: You'll use just under half the 170g tomato paste can — refrigerate the rest, it keeps 1–2 weeks. The ginger juliennes at the end aren't redundant with the ginger paste earlier — raw and matchstick-cut, they add a fresh, sharp bite the cooked paste doesn't have. Keeps 3 days refrigerated; reheat on the stovetop with a splash of water — high-power microwaving toughens the paneer.
